svg.title: Leaf measured optimization loop
svg.desc: Calibration and held-out evaluation use independent data splits. Offline candidates are compared against native FP32 and the best PyTorch baseline on the same full workload and hardware. Generation latency uses last-token-only logits and identical KV-cache semantics; full-logit quality is evaluated separately. Automatic promotion requires trained-model quality gates, stable repeated timings for candidates and references, and no prefill or decode slowdown. Noisy or unmatched measurements cannot promote an optimization. A failed candidate stays unpromoted; profiling, a scoped change, export, and both gates repeat. Passing results apply only to the tested configuration.
svg.text: Leaf measured optimization loop
Implement → verify → measure → profile → improve. Candidate precision is not a performance claim.
Calibration split
Representative inputs for quantization statistics
No held-out evaluation examples used for calibration
Held-out evaluation split
Model-independent dataset and input adapters
References and candidates receive identical inputs
INDEPENDENT
DATA SPLITS
Prepare candidates offline
Rewrite, quantize and export candidate artifacts
Calibration uses only the calibration split
Native FP32 remains the safe default
Reference baselines
Best PyTorch configuration + native FP32
Match last-token logits, KV mode and threads
Measure the full workload, not only a proxy kernel
Full-workload evaluation on held-out inputs
Trained-model quality
Next-token agreement and perplexity
or dataset task accuracy and output parity
Fixed acceptance thresholds; record failures too
Whole-workload latency
Prefill and decode measured separately
Warm-up + stable repeated timings + matched settings
Check variability in candidates and both reference paths
Promotion gate: quality AND stable measured speed
Quality thresholds pass; stable prefill and decode do not regress
Reject noisy results; require a whole-model improvement over both references
PASS BOTH GATES
FAIL EITHER GATE
Promote for this tested configuration
Record artifact, runtime, inputs and CPU identity
Reuse validated precision; retain FP32 fallback
Other architectures or hardware require new validation
Keep the candidate unpromoted
Profile bottlenecks and change one factor at a time
Re-export and repeat quality plus latency checks
No unvalidated automatic precision selection
Iterative development continues until a candidate passes both gates, or the verified FP32 path is retained.
